author: OpenAI
title: OpenAI Help Center now documents textGrain watermarking as active for EU ChatGPT text
summary: OpenAI's updated provenance documentation now states that ChatGPT-generated text in the EU includes textGrain invisible statistical watermarks, while API customers globally can opt in. This is a meaningful operational update from OpenAI's October 5 announcement, which described EU ChatGPT/Codex rollout as occurring over the coming weeks.
original_claim: OpenAI uses textGrain watermarks for ChatGPT-generated text in the EU; API customers globally can enable text watermarking.
what_changed: The current Help Center language describes EU ChatGPT text watermarking in the present tense, whereas the October 5 announcement said the EU rollout would occur over the coming weeks.
why_it_matters: This changes the provenance characteristics of ChatGPT-generated text for EU users and matters for downstream reuse, detection, compliance, and evaluation of generated text.
reason: First-party documentation was updated within the scan window and indicates a meaningful deployment-state change.
